description: Seeded, periodic texture generators: colour, height, roughness and emissive per texel, with their parameters, size, tile, density and look.

fields.description: What it draws, in plain sentences.
Its parameters as schema fields (engine/core/schema.ts: type, default, description, minimum…), each with a default: what a material's map may set.
The size it bakes at, [width, height] in texels: a whole number of tiles.
The smallest size its pattern repeats at, given the parameters: (params) => [width, height].
Texels per metre on geometry whose UVs are in metres (WP 2.4's builders): the map repeats every size / density metres.
How it is magnified: 'pixel' keeps texels crisp (nearest), 'smooth' blends them (linear).
The generator: ({ params, seed, width, height }) => (x, y, texel) => void, writing texel (x, y): color (sRGB bytes), height, roughness, emissive.
